question: What publisher-authored knowledge inside Thompson pistol targets can SCZN3 turn into useful after-shot guidance without inventing instruction?

population.boundary: Six diagnostic identities, TAC, and Threat Code RED carry target-level instructional meaning; Progressive Pistol and Premium Handgun are commercial compositions.

result.reason: Public evidence proves the knowledge exists, but production use still requires exact licensed authority packaging; some experiences also need UGO, timing provenance, subject continuity, or new Founder approval for corrective guidance.

records.productName: Group Shooter Handgun - Paper Diagnostic Shooting Targets - 19"x25"
records.authorityGrade: publisher meaning visible; exact licensed production transcription required

publisherKnowledge.method: Locate a shot or group in a target sector, then follow that sector to Thompson's printed problem and correction.
publisherKnowledge.handedness: Distinct right- and left-handed guidance is printed.

records.sczn3CurrentTruth: May preserve observations and match exact governed publisher regions/labels. Current Diagnostic V1 may not infer a dominant group diagnosis or emit corrective advice.
records.minimumAdditionalAuthorityOrCapability: Licensed versioned region/handedness/guidance profile plus Founder-approved Diagnostic extension for publisher-authored guidance presentation.

records.productName: TAC Target (Training With Audible Cues) 19"x25" Shooting Targets & Cue Card
records.authorityGrade: public publisher Cue Card establishes the drill; target UGO/licensing and timing evidence still govern execution claims

publisherKnowledge.participants: At least two as designed: shooter and partner/caller; solo practice is described separately.
sequence: Choose shot count and one published cue set; designate the partner/caller and timer operator.
Start in low ready; start the timer with the first cue; engage the corresponding torso.
After every shot return to low ready; the partner then gives the next cue.
After the final shot stop time, secure the firearm, score the target, and divide total score by elapsed seconds for Time Factor Score.
publisherKnowledge.timeFactorFormula: total score divided by elapsed seconds
publisherKnowledge.nextStep: The Cue Card says the next shooter may fix a target downrange and repeat the drill.

records.sczn3CurrentTruth: Cue/Drill can own cue selection, sequence, backend event state and terminal SEC. It cannot represent manual impact entry as physical shot timing.
records.minimumAdditionalAuthorityOrCapability: Exact target UGO, Cue Card licensing/version, admitted clock/timer provenance and response-to-cue reconciliation. No new family required.

records.productName: HALO Threat Code: RED Reactive Splatter Shooting Game Targets 12.5"x19"
records.authorityGrade: publisher rules and printed values visible; exact scenario/region geometry required

publisherKnowledge.rule: Positive points come from red threat scoring areas; black innocent/negative areas subtract points.
publisherKnowledge.optionalDifficulty: Publisher suggests moving farther away or adding a timer.

records.sczn3CurrentTruth: Recreational Challenge can score governed zones; Decision may be offered separately. Artwork cannot itself establish threat or tactical truth.
records.minimumAdditionalAuthorityOrCapability: Exact four-panel UGO, value map and clarification whether/how the four panels are sequenced. Pistol-specific applicability is not established by the reviewed page.
